FLASHCARD · UPPERCASE ALPHABET · AGES 3–4 YEARS

Letter M Flashcard — the Big Letter M (Moon)

Moon starts with the big letter M. This card is just that big letter — one bright shape on a clean page, so all your child’s eyes see is the letter itself.

Draw on this card: pick a crayon under the picture, write or color right on the card with a finger, a stylus or the mouse, then tap “Save my work” to keep a copy. Nothing is uploaded anywhere — the drawing stays on your device.

← LionPrevious cardNest →Next card

Say it together

“M is for moon. Mmm — moon! Good night, moon.”

Say it naturally, then wait. Whatever comes back — the letter, the word, a point, a giggle — is the right answer.

Try this

After the card, hunt for the letter: “can you find a big M on the cereal box?” Letters spotted on real things around the house stick better than any printable.
